ITA-9.6.53 śarārimukhaśastram शरारिमुखशस्त्रम्
Scissors
A double-bladed sharp instrument for cutting in surgery.
ITA-

.2 śarāvaḥ शरावः
Earthen cupel or saucer
A utensil generally used for refining metals and minerals, and for calcinating metals and minerals using graded heat.
ITA-5.4

śarāvikā-pramehapiḍakā शराविका-प्रमेहपिडका
Carbuncle resembling earthenware vessel with flat cover
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a boil with raised margins; bluish-black lesions; accompanied by wetness/dampness; pain; resembling an earthen saucer; a boil with a depressed centre.
ITA-

śarīra-vṛddhikara-bhāvaḥ शरीरवृद्धिकरभावः
Factors responsible for body growth
Body growth is determined by four factors: appropriate time, innate nature, proper nutrition and absence of obstructing or impairing factors.
ITA-

śarīra-sampat शरीरसम्पत्
Healthy body and mind
The state in which all fundamental structural components of the body or dhatu are functioning normally.

ITA-4.8.39 śarīrādhiṣṭānaṃ शरीराधिष्टानम्
Physical body as seat of disease
A disease or condition in which the body is first affected followed by the mind.
ITA-

śarīrārdham शरीरार्धम्
Body half
ITA-

avayavaḥ, śarīrāvayavaḥ अवयवः, शरीरावयवः
A body part or organ

ITA-5.39.8 śarkarājamūtrakṛcchram, śarkarā-aśmarī शर्कराजमूत्रकृच्छ्रम्, शर्करा-अश्मरी
Difficulty in urination due to urinary gravel
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: precordial pain/cardiac pain; shivering/ tremors; colicky pain in abdomen; diminution of agni; syncope or swooning; severe dysuria; lessening of pain when gravel passed in urine flow.

ITA-5.62.21 śarkarārbudaḥ शर्करार्बुदः
Granulated tumour
A disorder characterized by a swelling of variegated coloration; moistening/soddening; foul smell; sudden occurrence of bleeding; honey-like discharge; clarified butterlike discharge; discharge resembling fat.
ITA-

śārīraḥ शारीरः
Knowledge pertaining to the body
The study of the body in all its aspects from origin to death.

ITA-9.6.196 śārīraśalyam शारीरशल्यम्
Endogenous internal obstruction
An obstruction originating from factors such as vitiated excretory products and morbid matter or a calculus.
ITA-

tridoṣaḥ, śārīrikadoṣa त्रिदोषः, शारीरिकदोष
Three doshas or tridosha
The three regulatory functional factors of the body are: vata, pitta and kapha.
ITA-

śārīrikahetuḥ शारीरिकहेतुः
Somatic cause
Causes leading to disturbances in the anatomy and physiology of the body.

ITA-1.10.2 Laghutrayī (Mādhavanidāna, Śārṅgadharasaṃhita, Bhāvaprakāśa) लघुत्रयी (माधवनिदान, शार्ङ्गधरसंहिता, भावप्रकाश)
Lesser triad of Ayurveda texts
The supportive texts of Ayurveda. Madhavanidana, Sharangadharasamhita and Bhavaprakāśa.

ITA-1.9.4.2.19 saraḥ सरः
Instability, mobility
The quality of a substance which is responsible for stimulation and mobility (preraṇa), and which governs normal movements such as peristalsis.

ITA-2.8.1.1 sāraḥ सारः
Predominance of a particular fundamental structural component in a person
ITA-

.3 svarjikṣāraḥ, sarjikṣāraḥ, sarjikākṣāraḥ. स्वर्जिक्षारः, सर्जिक्षारः, सर्जिकाक्षारः
Alkali containing mainly sodium bicarbonate

ITA-2.8.21 sarpakāyaḥ सर्पकायः
Person with The characteristics of the person with a simultaneously brave simultaneously brave and timid temperament are strength or sharpness of action, and timid temperament laboriousness, cowardice, angriness, deceptiveness, and quickness of action and behaviour.

ITA-5.63.70 sarvasaramukharogaḥ सर्वसरमुखरोगः
Global oral cavity disorder Disorders of the ear
ITA-

sarvāṅgaḥ सर्वाङ्गः
Whole body
ITA-

.32 sarvāṅgavātaḥ/ sarvāṅgarogaḥ सर्वाङ्गवातः/सर्वाङ्गरोगः
Paraparesis
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: flickering/twitching of various parts of body; bursting type of pain in joints; feeling as if limbs are being broken; severe pain; pricking pain; breaking type of pain; pulsating sensation; stiffening of body; convulsions; joint contraction; joint trembling.

ITA-5.73.36 sarvāṅgābhighataḥ सर्वाङ्गाभिहतः
Multiorgan injuries

ITA-9.8.18 sarvopaghātaśamanīyarasāyanam सर्वोपघातशमनीयरसायनम्
Rejuvenation therapy for pacifying all ailments
Rejuvenation therapy in its broad aspects as a curative for all ailments.

ITA-5.58.16 sarṣapikā सर्षपिका
Boils resembling white mustard seeds on the penis
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: boils resembling white mustard seeds; eruptions resembling white mustard seeds in shape and size; thick and firm lesion; mustard seed-sized boil.
ITA-5.4

sarṣapikāpramehapiḍakā सर्षपिका-प्रमेहपिडका
Carbuncle characterized by lesions resembling white mustard seeds
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a not very big boil suppurating quickly; very painful; resembling a heap of white mustard seedsized eruptions.

ITA-5.72.9 sāra-viṣaḥ सार-विषः
Poisonous resinous exudates
Poisoning characterized by halitosis; roughness/dryness; headache; secretion of mucus.
ITA-

sārasam सारसम्
Lake water
A type of water obtained from lakes.
